title: Pipeline schema mapping catalog and SDK scaffold for telemetry evolution
creator: Aisha Patel
description: As we evolve telemetry shapes across SDK, CLI, and gateway layers we need a single source of truth that maps historical event variants to the canonical analytics schema and an SDK scaffold generator to speed client migrations. This ticket drives a compact mapping catalog service plus a lightweight SDK shim generator and a staged backfill playbook so that the Console ingestion pipeline can accept multiple historical envelopes while producing a single normalized event stream for downstream analytics and billing. The work prioritizes minimal runtime impact, clear per-tenant overrides, and an automated validation harness to prevent silent data regressions.
acceptance_criteria: A mapping catalog service exists (read-only API) that returns canonical field mappings and transformation hints for a given historical schema tag
An SDK scaffold generator produces language-specific telemetry helper modules (JS/TS, Python, Go) that emit canonical envelopes with minimal friction
Ingestion layer applies mapping lookups without adding >5ms median latency for sampled traffic
Staged backfill plan and scripts are validated in staging and include idempotent transforms and checkpointed replays
Automated compatibility tests run in CI comparing pre- and post-normalization event counts for key dimensions (user_id, route, model_id) with +/-1% tolerance
notes: We intentionally keep the catalog read-only for now; write operations are handled by release engineering via a gated Confluence-to-catalog import
Per-tenant overrides: catalog returns a prioritized list of mappings (global -> org -> route) and a small Lua-like transform snippet when necessary
SDK scaffold should expose a single function generateTelemetry(event, context) that callers can drop in without learning the full mapping DSL
Backfill plan includes a sampling driver to run full replays for 10% of events and sampled dry-runs for remaining tenants to reduce cost
We will reuse the staging pipeline and leverage existing replay tooling from ENG-37688 and the schema validator from ENG-71234 as adapters
progress_updates: 2025-02-14: Kickoff meeting with product (Sofia Ramos) and observability (Evan Brooks). Defined initial set of canonical fields and key dimensions for billing and SLOs.
2025-02-20: PoC mapping catalog service (read-only) implemented as a lightweight HTTP service returning mapping bundles stored in S3. PoC includes v0 mappings for 'generate' and 'embed' envelopes.
2025-02-28: Early SDK scaffold prototype (TS + Python) committed: exposes generateTelemetry helper and auto-inserts schema_tag header. Need linting and packaging work.
2025-03-03: Ingestion hook integrated with catalog lookup; end-to-end normalization on staging shows 2.7ms median added latency for sampled path. Performance within target.

2025-03-05: Added compatibility tests to CI and created canary pipeline to run backfills for internal org 'redwood-alpha' at 1% traffic. Monitoring dashboards created in Grafana (console-telemetry-normalization).
Blocked: Awaiting release-engineering signoff on catalog mutation process and Confluence import script (ticketed out).
